newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-W jumps on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-W jumps on institutional buying.

text.p: Polish construction firm Mostostal Warszawa SA surged for the third straight session, rising 9.4 percent to 18.7 zlotys in a moderate 1.7-million-zloty turnover, likely on foreign instututional buying, traders said.
"This stock is considered very attractive by foreigners. The rally seems to be caused by them," one trader said.
Analysts said it was difficult to say whether the stock would continue its growth.
Mostostal Warszawa surged 20.4 percent in the last two sessions. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
